verdict.rationale: The OCR 4.1 model page lists a batching endpoint (/v1/batch), and a community tester mentions batched pricing, so Mistral has a first-party bulk path. However, nothing documents rate limits, throughput, or million-page scale, and one user reports a 900-page synchronous API call timed out and had to be split into chunks. missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, throughput or latency guarantees for batch jobs, batch job docs (size limits, completion windows), independent evidence of million-page batch runs.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I push high-volume batches — millions of pages — with documented rate limits and predictable throughput

citations.quote: was confused about what 'batched' pricing ($1/1000 pages, or 2k pages batched) actually means
